exposure: presence and severity of typical comorbidities of preterm birth
outcome: coefficient of variation of body temperature
scaling exponent alpha (Talpha) of temperature fluctuations
cohort: The study included 73 incubator-nursed preterm infants with a mean gestational age of 30.1 weeks (range 24.0-34.0 weeks).
finding: There was a positive association of the scaling exponent alpha (Talpha) of body temperature fluctuations with increasing levels of respiratory support, even after adjusting for gestational age and birth weight z-score.
followup_time: Within the first five days of life (with 3-hour time series recordings)
birth_weight: Included as 'body size at birth' and 'birth weight z-score' in the analysis, but specific weights are not provided.
